```{r Libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r Daten_einlesen}
kunden_feedback <- read_csv("data/kunden_feedback.csv")
kunden_feedback %>%
  summarize(mean = round(mean(Rating),2))
kunden_feedback_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(kunden_feedback, pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
```

```{r Prompt_Funktion}
interpret_voc_ollama <- function(voc_json, model) {

  prompt <- paste0(
    "You work in Customer Service.\n",
    "The following data is a list of customer feedback entries as JSON objects.\n",
    "Each item contains: 'Datum', 'Kommentar', and 'Rating'.\n\n",
    "Your tasks:\n",
    "1. Classify each entry into one of: Service Quality, Response Time, Accessibility & Channels, or Process & Platform Issues.\n",
    "2. Identify which categories drive negative ratings.\n",
    "3. Identify weekly trends.\n",
    "4. Give one short action recommendation.\n\n",
    "Be as concise as possible, only answer the questions. Customer Feedback JSON:\n",
    voc_json,
    "\n\nYour interpretation:"
  )

  url <- "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"

  body <- list(
    model = model,
    prompt = prompt,
    stream = FALSE
  )

  res <- httr::POST(
    url,
    body = jsonlite::toJSON(body, auto_unbox = TRUE),
    httr::add_headers("Content-Type" = "application/json")
  )

  json <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr::content(res, as = "text"))
  json$response
}
```

```{r Ausfuehrung}
result <- interpret_voc_ollama(kunden_feedback_json, model = "llama3.1")
cat(result)
```
